# Values

Lists the property values of an object.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Values(source)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | object | The object whose property values to list. Null is read as an empty object. Any other value that is not an object is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. An array of the property values, as they are, in the order the object holds them, so in the same order as `Keys` gives the names. The empty array for an empty object. Never null.

## Example

`Values({"a": 1, "b": 2})` returns `[1, 2]`.
